decision_policy: The evaluator may authorize a measured overhead even when that overhead is large.
A point estimate without the frozen paired confidence interval cannot authorize a paper claim.
Any failed integrity or stability gate retains the run as negative evidence and requires diagnosis before rerun.
No threshold may be changed after viewing the formal measurements.
scientific_boundary: Single source and one unique, non-null, unmasked STRING record key.
Join, Aggregate, SpatialJoin, composite keys, and non-STRING keys are unsupported.
This experiment measures record-evidence construction and verification, not the broader optimizer.
